title: ToolSchema
description: TASK-103 (revised): Meta-schema for individual tool schemas. Every tool must have a JSON Schema conforming to this shape. Note: `version` here is the meta-schema version (1.0), NOT the tool's own version (which lives under stability/version in capability-matrix).

input.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the tool input.

output.description: Every tool returns the unified envelope.

risk_level.description: Per v2 §10 + ADR-0021; drives policy gating.

requires_approval.description: If true, runtime MUST pause for human approval before execution.

idempotent.description: Tool is safe to retry with the same args (per HTTP RFC 7231 / idempotency-key contract).
